judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant but ordinary fair-weather sky, mostly empty blue with a few scattered clouds and no striking light or structure.
strengths: some layered cloud structure near the horizon
weaknesses: large empty expanse of plain blue
flat midday light with little contrast or drama
treetops at bottom are incidental and awkwardly cropped
